summary.value: Romer Hell's Kitchen sits at 851 Eighth Ave. New York City, New York 10019, and its story is a makeover: The 295-guestroom hotel took over a former Hampton Inn and now styles itself so you just might feel like you wandered into a local legend's living room. It suits theater nights and first-timers, since one Tripadvisor guest found it in a great location, easy walk to Times Square, Theater District, MOMA, and 5th Avenue. Rooms run large for Manhattan (Time Out: Guestrooms measure up to 600 square feet), evenings center on So & So's piano bar with nightly live entertainment where anybody just might drop in, and Neighborhood Café is an all-day reprieve for coffee. The honest catch is the bathroom, tiny even for New York standards, and one guest found The bathroom was too cramped.

description.value: Romer Hell's Kitchen is a design-forward Midtown West hotel on Eighth Avenue, steps from Times Square and Broadway, built around a neighborhood-living-room idea. Room types range from a Deluxe King to a One Bedroom King Suite that sleeps four, and the Corner King welcomes guests with a sprawling velvet couch. Families get Two Queens, and the hotel says Choose from accessible king, two-queen and one-bedroom suite layouts for two to four guests. Pets and cars are welcome: Bring along your pet and we’ll provide the treats, bed, and bowls to make their visit extra special, and a package lets you Stay with us and enjoy parking included in your reservation. Tripadvisor (search snapshot) shows Reviews 4.5 Very Good (616), with Rooms Spacious and Cleanliness Spotless. Representative praise: “The beds were super comfortable and the bathroom was modern” and “Our room was quiet and well soundproofed”; one reviewer adds “The piano bar was fantastic”. Representative watch-outs: “The bathrooms were fairly tiny”, and Time Out calls the bathroom tiny even for New York standards.
